The '''Umbaran blaster pistol''' also known as '''Umbaran blaster rifle''' was used by the [[Umbaran militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was an advanced version of blaster technology and was not commonly used outside of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. It fired green blaster bolts.<ref name="DoU" />
